label: GO, late episode (trial >= ~83): choosing a2 again after an unrewarded visit to S2
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), only in the last ~20 trials of an episode (no activations before trial 70; 81% of mass in trials 90-99), almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.8% of mass prev_reward == 0) and mostly when it reached S2 via a2, and when the agent is about to pick a2 again (97% of mass action == 2 / model_act == 2; choice logit strongly toward a2). It goes with low value (89% of mass in the lowest value bin). It never fires at D1 or D2, after rewarded trials, or early in the episode. The predicate uses only observed history, episode position, and the agent own GO choice, so no future variables. Dev: P 0.92, R 0.69, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.84. Most misses are weak activations (e.g. GO for a2 after rewarded or rare trials, or GO for a1 after a loss); the episode-trial cutoff is soft. Magnitude modulation was not checked beyond this.
